paper_protocol.data_risk_heuristic: Cramers V is used only for ordering feasible candidates; at most three paired probes per run. No hard V promotion threshold.
paper_protocol.note: IRM input adapter; metadata-assisted training-only discovery. Frozen adaptive thresholds unchanged; probe a validation-selected ResNet18 seed42 then expand to ResNet18/50 seeds42/43/44 only when primary interval supports expansion. Paired red/green swaps and independent original OOD are distinct evidence.
paper_protocol.effect_reporting: Continuous signed paired effects and uncertainty; no universal 30pp shortcut/no-shortcut boundary.

split_protocol.isolation: SHA256 of max(RGB) digit foreground, groups isolated; training content overlapping original OOD excluded
split_protocol.original_test_role: original IRM independent OOD environment retained, unused for model selection

dataset_description: Binary handwritten digit classification from RGB 14x14 red/green foreground images on black backgrounds. The observed y column is the task target. Discovery receives only the training partition, with color verified against pixels; no construction truth or held-out statistics are supplied. Validation and held-out ID/OOD are isolated by recovered digit-content groups. Authorized red-green channel swapping preserves digit intensity and observed labels for paired ID comparisons; independent held-out environment comparison is separately authorized. Do not assume any expected verdict. Equivalent visual and metadata representations should be treated as one scientific hypothesis when evidence supports that equivalence.
